correctness.rationale: Two independent complete face enumerations give 2,648 nonempty simplices. Exact mod-two augmented boundary ranks (1,23,181,563,496,32) and reduced Euler characteristic -57 imply rational homology only in dimension three of rank 57. All 48 graph automorphisms preserve edges, and 478,080 oriented boundary-equivariance identities pass. Signed fixed-face Lefschetz traces give the ten class characters. The induced B3 bipartition characters are pairwise orthonormal and complete; exact inner products yield nonnegative integer multiplicities summing to 57 dimensions. Finite-group rational cochain averaging gives the quotient-ring consequence. This is an exhaustive finite proof with executable source.

originality.rationale: Exact same-object full public RESULT reports homotopy wedge 57 three-spheres, but no action on rational homology. The ten signed-cycle traces, ten multiplicities and one invariant quotient class are extra information not implied by that nonequivariant statement. Other inspected sources have distinct graph families or connectivity conclusions; no covering character decomposition was located. This is not a uniqueness proof.

value.rationale: The cuboctahedron is a canonical 48-symmetry polyhedral line graph. The earlier ordinary homotopy type gives only the number of homology generators, not their complete octahedral module. Determining all ten multiplicities, the 34/23 inversion eigenspaces and the single surviving quotient cohomology generator is a natural complete structural refinement with interpretable topological content rather than an arbitrary isolated numeric slice.
